title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
title_zh: MetaBench-Harness: 解锁基准套件端到端优化

paragraphs.en: Recent breakthroughs in Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) have showcased exceptional capabilities across diverse applications, from creative text generation to intricate problem-solving. Consequently, dynamic and rigorous evaluation frameworks have emerged as a vital research domain ( Lou et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2024 ) . Effective assessment frameworks offer deep insights into model strengths and limitations, assist practitioners in selecting suitable LLMs ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , and provide directional guidance for future architectural and algorithmic improvements, as highlighted in recent taxonomies addressing the evaluation trilemma ( Tiwari et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）（Achiam 等人，2023）近期的突破展示了其在多种应用中的卓越能力，从创意文本生成到复杂问题解决。 因此，动态且严谨的评估框架已成为一个至关重要的研究领域（Lou 等人，2025；Chang 等人，2024）。 有效的评估框架能深入揭示模型的优势与局限性，帮助从业者选择适合的 LLM（Zheng 等人，2023），并为未来的架构和算法改进提供方向性指导，正如近期针对评估三角困境的分类研究中所强调的那样（Tiwari 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: While various benchmarks have been introduced to evaluate LLMs, traditional static datasets are increasingly inadequate due to the rapid evolution of model capabilities and widespread data contamination ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , which occurs when public test sets inadvertently infiltrate training corpora and result in skewed evaluations. Although existing methods attempt to address these challenges through perplexity-based metrics or fine-grained semantic detection ( Di et al., 2026 ) , they remain limited by an over-reliance on static rules or poor task generalization. Consequently, while dynamic paradigms have emerged ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , preventing benchmark saturation through continuous and robust evolution remains a critical and largely unresolved challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有多种基准测试被提出用于评估大型语言模型（LLM），但由于模型能力的快速演进和数据污染现象的普遍存在，传统的静态数据集正变得越来越不足（Cheng 等，2025）。所谓数据污染，是指公共测试集无意中混入训练语料库，从而导致评估结果出现偏差。 虽然现有方法试图通过基于困惑度的指标或精细化的语义检测手段来应对这些挑战（Di 等，2026），但它们仍然受到过度依赖静态规则或任务泛化能力差的限制。 因此，尽管动态范式已经出现（Shi 等，2026），但如何通过持续且稳健的演化来防止基准测试的饱和，仍然是一个关键且尚未得到充分解决的挑战。

paragraphs.en: To meet this need, recent efforts have increasingly turned toward automated and self-evolving benchmarks designed to renew evaluation. However, current approaches still exhibit several limitations: frameworks like Benchmark Self-Evolving ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and AutoEvoEval ( Wu and Liu, 2025 ) apply predefined atomic operations that primarily probe robustness rather than genuinely scaling task complexity; specialized solutions like AdamMeme ( Chen et al., 2025 ) are restricted to narrow domains such as meme harmfulness; EvoCodeBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) relies on fixed ingestion schedules rather than model-driven exploration; and TRACE ( Guo et al., 2026 ) is confined to test-time exploration within specific real environments. However, reliance on these rigid and domain-specific mechanisms fails to provide a comprehensive solution to the ongoing risk of benchmark saturation.
paragraphs.zh: 为满足这一需求，近期的研究日益转向自动化且能自我演化的基准测试，旨在更新评估方式。 然而，现有方法仍存在若干局限性：例如，Benchmark Self-Evolving（Wang 等人，2025）和 AutoEvoEval（Wu 和 Liu，2025）等框架应用了预定义的原子操作，这些操作主要测试系统的鲁棒性，而非真正提升任务复杂度；AdamMeme（Chen 等人，2025）这类专用方案则局限于“梗”内容有害性等狭窄领域；EvoCodeBench（Li 等人，2024）依赖固定的输入处理流程，而非由模型驱动的探索；而 TRACE（Guo 等人，2026）则仅限于在特定真实环境中进行测试时的探索。 然而，依赖这些僵化且局限于特定领域的机制，无法为基准测试持续面临的能力饱和风险提供全面的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Overcoming these fragmented limitations requires moving beyond ad-hoc solutions. A practical benchmark generation framework must be grounded in three core pillars that directly address the aforementioned gaps: (1) Evolution , replacing rigid fixed processes and environment-restricted limits with dynamic, model-driven controllers that continuously adapt as target LLMs advance; (2) Discriminability , ensuring generated queries effectively test underlying capabilities rather than merely increasing difficulty, moving beyond superficial robustness checks; and (3) Diversity , ensuring that the evolved benchmarks and problems encompass diverse problem-solving techniques, target varying capability dimensions across tasks, and dynamically utilize different difficulty levers, rather than relying on uniform or narrow modifications. paragraphs.en: We propose MetaBench-Harness (Figure 1 ), a framework that operates over dual evolving timelines of benchmarks and harnesses. It orchestrates multi-round harness generation by feeding accumulated trajectory memory back into the search process, dynamically controlling access to prior code and execution traces to improve LLM benchmark quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MetaBench-Harness（图 1），这是一个在基准测试和工具的双重演化时间线中运行的框架。 它通过将累积的轨迹记忆反馈到搜索过程中，协调多轮工具生成，并动态控制对先前代码和执行轨迹的访问，以提高 LLM 基准测试的质量。

sents.en: It orchestrates multi-round harness generation by feeding accumulated trajectory memory back into the search process, dynamically controlling access to prior code and execution traces to improve LLM benchmark quality.
sents.zh: 它通过将累积的轨迹记忆反馈到搜索过程中，协调多轮工具生成，并动态控制对先前代码和执行轨迹的访问，以提高 LLM 基准测试的质量。

paragraphs.en: Applying MetaBench-Harness to the CodeContests and AIME-2024 benchmarks demonstrates its superior effectiveness compared to previous static evolution methods in benchmark generation (Table 1 ), while consistently producing challenging and discriminative tasks that induce performance degradation in prominent LLM systems (Table 2 , 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 将 MetaBench-Harness 应用于 CodeContests 和 AIME-2024 基准测试表明，与以往的静态演化方法相比，它在基准生成方面具有更卓越的有效性（表 1），同时能够持续生成具有挑战性和区分度的任务，这些任务会导致主流 LLM 系统的性能下降（表 2、3）。

paragraphs.en: Through comprehensive analyses across trajectories, quality assessment, and quantitative case studies, we reveal that our framework not only steadily improves benchmark competency and evaluator robustness, but also effectively utilizes difficulty levers to reframe problems. Ultimately, it provides a solution to benchmark saturation.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对不同轨迹的全面分析、质量评估和定量案例研究，我们发现我们的框架不仅能稳步提升基准测试能力和评估器的稳健性，还能有效利用难度调节机制来重新定义问题。 最终，它为解决基准测试饱和问题提供了方案。

paragraphs.en: Static vs. Dynamic Benchmark Generation. Recent developments in dynamic evaluation seek to counter the swift saturation of static datasets. Early efforts like Benchmark Self-Evolving ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and AutoEvoEval ( Wu and Liu, 2025 ) use predefined atomic operations for NLP reasoning and multiple-choice QA, testing surface-level robustness rather than scaling task complexity. Specialized frameworks target specific niches, such as AdamMeme ( Chen et al., 2025 ) leveraging multi-agent collaboration for safety probing, or EvoCodeBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) refreshing software benchmarks at rigid temporal intervals without active model feedback. While advanced test-time exploration approaches like TRACE ( Guo et al., 2026 ) pioneer autonomous task generation, they remain bound by predefined generative pathways. Overcoming these restrictions requires a fully dynamic pipeline. Through an outer-loop meta-harness orchestration that selectively controls the proposer’s access to historical code and execution traces, MetaBench-Harness enables a truly dynamic benchmark generation pipeline that continuously adapts to target LLM advancements.
paragraphs.zh: 静态与动态基准生成。 动态基准生成。 动态评估领域的最新进展旨在应对静态数据集迅速饱和的问题。 早期的尝试，如 Benchmark Self-Evolving（Wang 等，2025）和 AutoEvoEval（Wu 和 Liu，2025），使用预定义的原子操作进行自然语言处理推理和多项选择问答测试，仅检验表层稳健性，而非提升任务复杂度。 专用框架针对特定领域，例如 AdamMeme（Chen 等，2025）利用多智能体协作进行安全性探测，或 EvoCodeBench（Li 等，2024）以固定的时间间隔更新软件基准，且无主动模型反馈。 尽管 TRACE（Guo 等，2026）这类先进的测试时探索方法开创性地实现了自主任务生成，但它们仍受限于预定义的生成路径。 克服这些限制需要一个完全动态的流程。 通过外层循环元框架的协调，选择性控制提案器对历史代码和执行轨迹的访问权限，MetaBench-Harness 实现了一个真正动态的基准生成流程，能够持续适应目标大型语言模型的发展。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive Utilization of External Knowledge. Several studies demonstrate that models benefit from treating large repositories or lengthy contexts as dynamically accessed external assets rather than consuming them in a single pass. While early paradigms include retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) and alternating retrieval-reasoning ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) , recent advances further introduce active associative discovery ( Li et al., 2026 ) for fragmented evidence and targeted delta planning ( Chou et al., 2026 ) for information gaps. Together with memory-enabled agents ( Packer et al., 2023 ) and recursive models ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , these methods highlight a shift toward adaptive context interaction. MetaBench-Harness applies this retrieval pattern within a benchmark-driven harness engineering loop, granting the proposer unrestricted access to historical code, scores, and execution traces to discover and improve end-to-end context handling procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 外部知识的自适应利用。 多项研究表明，模型通过将大型知识库或冗长上下文视为动态访问的外部资源，而非一次性全部处理，能够获得更好的效果。 早期的范式包括检索增强生成（Lewis 等，2020）和交替检索-推理（Trivedi 等，2023），而近期的进展则进一步引入了针对碎片化证据的主动关联发现（Li 等，2026）以及针对信息缺失的靶向增量规划（Chou 等，2026）。 结合具备记忆能力的智能体（Packer 等，2023）和递归模型（Zhang 等，2025a），这些方法凸显了向自适应上下文交互模式的转变。 MetaBench-Harness 在基准驱动的引擎工程循环中应用了这种检索模式，使提案者能够无限制地访问历史代码、评分和执行轨迹，从而发现并改进端到端的上下文处理流程。

paragraphs.en: Search Over Executable Code. Modern approaches increasingly explore executable code spaces to discover functions, workflows, or agent architectures. Early investigations integrated large models as mutation and crossover engines within evolutionary program search ( Lehman et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent techniques advanced to evolving specific functions inside fixed code frameworks ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , deploying meta-agents to synthesize new agents from historical findings ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , or optimizing workflow graphs for agentic systems ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Another research direction focuses on memory structures that enable continual-learning agents to retain information across multiple tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) . Closely related is Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , which searches over domain-specific task harnesses using a minimal outer loop with unrestricted filesystem access. paragraphs.en: Meta-Harness Orchestration Guided by Trajectory Memory. To drive the iterative evolution of the benchmark harness over time, the meta-harness orchestration mechanism employs an LLM-based agent ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} conditioned on an accumulated trajectory memory 𝒯 \mathcal{T} to propose candidate harness updates. Unlike prior systems relying on manual search heuristics to drive improvements, we delegate diagnosis and harness generation directly to the agent through a cohesive four-step workflow. First, acting as the proposer , the agent inspects uncompressed raw artifacts from 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , including past harness code, generated benchmarks, and execution traces, to generate candidate updates to the incumbent harness H ( t − 1 ) H^{(t-1)} . Second, an evaluator simply scores and ranks these proposals to help identify promising candidates. Third, a selector chooses the best benchmark harness candidate from the rankings. Finally, the applier applies the approved change to instantiate the evolved benchmark harness H ( t ) H^{(t)} , which subsequently drives the inner execution loop to generate the new benchmark checkpoint B ( t ) B^{(t)} . Relying on the uncompressed, accumulated trajectory memory, our meta-harness orchestration enables precise error diagnosis, prevents redundant search paths, and effectively guides the selection toward optimal benchmark harness evolution across generations.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark Generation Governed by Agentic Harness. To generate high-quality benchmarks using the evolving benchmark harness, the inner execution loop runs once per optimization round t t using the updated harness H ( t ) H^{(t)} , a seed benchmark B seed B_{\text{seed}} , and proxy models ℳ 1 \mathcal{M}_{1} and ℳ 2 \mathcal{M}_{2} . Operated through a coding agent with shell-level access, this agentic harness workflow executes a four-stage process to produce the benchmark B ( t ) B^{(t)} and its validation- and audit-derived telemetry for subsequent optimization rounds. Overall, structured into two core phases, the pipeline balances generative creation with rigorous governance. The first part, encompassing Scenario Discovery and Task & Eval Synthesis , systematically generates novel tasks paired with deterministic evaluators. Subsequently, the second part, comprising Model Validation and Lifecycle Audit , executes these tasks and governs their lifecycles to produce critical execution telemetry, feeding this data directly back into the outer loop of meta-harness orchestration to drive subsequent iterations. First, during Scenario Discovery , the agent explores new problem directions for task evolution by mutating selected seed items into diverse candidate scenarios, with redundant copies and invalid replays excluded by the novelty filter. Second, building upon these candidate scenarios, Task & Eval Synthesis synthesizes concrete task families paired with shared deterministic evaluators, while an internal validity filter discards failing tasks. Third, Model Validation executes the generated benchmark suite across the proxy models to capture responses, intermediate artifacts, and objective metrics, thereby producing the execution telemetry required by the outer loop optimization. Fourth, building directly upon these validation outcomes, the final stage, Lifecycle Audit , assigns discrete scenario-level management states ( Keep-and-Evolve , Keep-Stable , Reseed ) to each scenario, sustainably steering the benchmark’s evolution and maximizing search efficiency rather than simply discarding search budgets. Ultimately, this continuous cycle of generation, validation, and curation feeds directly into the meta-harness, driving progressive improvements across successive optimization rounds.

sents.en: Operated through a coding agent with shell-level access, this agentic harness workflow executes a four-stage process to produce the benchmark B ( t ) B^{(t)} and its validation- and audit-derived telemetry for subsequent optimization rounds.
sents.zh: 该智能体驱动框架流程通过具有 shell 级访问权限的编码智能体运行，执行一个四阶段过程，以生成基准 B^{(t)} 及其来自验证与审计的遥测数据，供后续优化轮次使用。

sents.en: Overall, structured into two core phases, the pipeline balances generative creation with rigorous governance.
sents.zh: 总体而言，该流程分为两个核心阶段，在生成性创建与严格治理之间取得平衡。

sents.en: The first part, encompassing Scenario Discovery and Task & Eval Synthesis , systematically generates novel tasks paired with deterministic evaluators.
sents.zh: 第一阶段包括场景发现与任务及评估合成，系统性地生成新的任务并为其配备确定性评估器。

sents.en: Subsequently, the second part, comprising Model Validation and Lifecycle Audit , executes these tasks and governs their lifecycles to produce critical execution telemetry, feeding this data directly back into the outer loop of meta-harness orchestration to drive subsequent iterations.
sents.zh: 随后，第二阶段包括模型验证与生命周期审计，执行这些任务并管理其生命周期，以产生关键执行遥测数据，并将这些数据直接反馈到元框架协调的外部循环中，以驱动后续迭代。

sents.en: First, during Scenario Discovery , the agent explores new problem directions for task evolution by mutating selected seed items into diverse candidate scenarios, with redundant copies and invalid replays excluded by the novelty filter.
sents.zh: 首先，在场景发现阶段，智能体通过变异选定的初始项为生成多样化的候选场景来探索任务演化的新方向，同时由新颖性过滤器排除冗余副本和无效重演。

sents.en: Second, building upon these candidate scenarios, Task & Eval Synthesis synthesizes concrete task families paired with shared deterministic evaluators, while an internal validity filter discards failing tasks.
sents.zh: 其次，基于这些候选场景，任务及评估合成阶段会合成具体的任务族及其共享的确定性评估器，同时内部有效性过滤器会丢弃失败的任务。

sents.en: Third, Model Validation executes the generated benchmark suite across the proxy models to capture responses, intermediate artifacts, and objective metrics, thereby producing the execution telemetry required by the outer loop optimization.
sents.zh: 第三，模型验证阶段在代理模型上执行生成的基准套件，以捕获响应、中间产物和客观指标，从而产生外部循环优化所需的执行遥测数据。

sents.en: Fourth, building directly upon these validation outcomes, the final stage, Lifecycle Audit , assigns discrete scenario-level management states ( Keep-and-Evolve , Keep-Stable , Reseed ) to each scenario, sustainably steering the benchmark’s evolution and maximizing search efficiency rather than simply discarding search budgets.
sents.zh: 第四，直接基于这些验证结果，最后的生命周期审计阶段为每个场景分配离散的场景级管理状态（保留并演化、保持稳定、重新播种），可持续地引导基准的演化并最大化搜索效率，而非简单丢弃搜索资源。

sents.en: Ultimately, this continuous cycle of generation, validation, and curation feeds directly into the meta-harness, driving progressive improvements across successive optimization rounds.
sents.zh: 最终，这一持续生成、验证与筛选的循环直接反馈到元框架中，推动连续优化轮次的逐步改进。

paragraphs.en: End-to-End Optimization Procedure and Deliverables. To clearly illustrate the dual-loop operation, we formalize the procedure as pseudocode in Algorithm 1 . The procedure begins by initializing the trajectory memory using a predefined benchmark harness and a seed dataset. The optimization then executes over T T rounds, with each round comprising two main stages: harness proposal and benchmark generation. During the harness proposal stage, the LLM agent generates K K candidate configurations, and an LLM-as-a-judge mechanism evaluates these candidates to select the optimal benchmark harness. In the subsequent generation stage, the inner loop leverages this selected harness and seed data to evolve prior scenarios, accumulating them into the updated benchmark suite. This suite then undergoes a ValidateAndAudit phase, where proxy models execute the benchmark to provide empirical feedback for subsequent evolution. This validation score, alongside the round’s harness and benchmark states, is appended to the trajectory memory to guide future search iterations. Upon completing all T T rounds, the procedure outputs the fully optimized evaluation benchmark and its corresponding harness configuration. Note that although the trajectory memory comprehensively logs all execution artifacts in practice, its representation is simplified here for clarity.

paragraphs.en: Module Instantiation of MetaBench-Harness . Within our framework, the core modules are operationalized by an LLM agent ( ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} ) guided by structured Markdown scaffolds. These templates explicitly define the expected functionality, inputs, outputs, and operational constraints for each distinct module. Furthermore, because our optimization objective is to discover a harness that yields challenging yet highly discriminative questions, we employ two distinct LLMs to serve as the underlying proxy models ( ℳ 1 \mathcal{M}_{1} and ℳ 2 \mathcal{M}_{2} ) during the ValidateAndAudit phase. Specific model choices, system prompts, and detailed empirical setups are deferred to Section 4 and Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: In our implementation of MetaBench-Harness , we instantiate the central agent ( ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} ) with Claude-Sonnet-5 ( Anthropic, 2026c ) , and employ both Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as the proxy models ( ℳ 1 \mathcal{M}_{1} and ℳ 2 \mathcal{M}_{2} ) to provide the necessary difficulty and discrimination signals during the search phase. Driven by this setup, we assess the framework’s efficacy by evolving benchmarks in the domains of coding and mathematics. Specifically, we utilize CodeContests ( Li et al., 2022 ) and AIME-2024 ( Jia, 2024 ) as our foundational seed datasets, executing the optimization procedure for T = 10 T=10 and T = 5 T=5 rounds respectively, to yield the final suites denoted as MB-CodeContests and MB-AIME. Because the framework equips each newly generated task with a programmatic evaluator, a model’s prediction is considered correct only upon passing this execution check; consequently, we adopt pass rate (accuracy) as our primary evaluation metric.

paragraphs.en: Model Performance Across Different Evolution Methods. We compare model performance across benchmark variants evolved from the AIME-2024 dataset, primarily focusing on MetaBench-Harness and its two ablated baselines, alongside AutoEvoEval ( Wu and Liu, 2025 ) and TRACE ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . The Baseline refers to the original, unevolved AIME-2024 evaluation dataset. Naïve Prompting consists solely of Scenario Discovery and Task & Eval Synthesis (Figure 2 b), omitting execution feedback entirely. Fixed Harness omits the outer-loop meta-harness orchestration (Figure 2 a) and relies only on a static harness (Figure 2 b). For AutoEvoEval , we select code- and math-related execution units for benchmark evolution, whereas for TRACE, we report their published results. Evaluation results summarized in Table 1 highlight the distinct impacts of these design choices. Specifically, while Baseline evaluations suffer from severe saturation (yielding up to 0.900 0.900 accuracy on DeepSeek ), alternative methods offer only marginal difficulty scaling. Naïve Prompting even exacerbates this issue: without execution feedback to verify viability, generation collapses into trivial or flawed tasks where top models score a perfect 1.000 1.000 . In contrast, MetaBench-Harness systematically drives down performance across all models, dropping DeepSeek to 0.322 0.322 and Qwen-7B to 0.044 0.044 . This demonstrates that both inner-loop execution feedback and outer-loop meta-harness orchestration are essential to eliminate performance saturation and expose fine-grained model capabilities.

sents.en: Evaluation results summarized in Table 1 highlight the distinct impacts of these design choices.

sents.en: Specifically, while Baseline evaluations suffer from severe saturation (yielding up to 0.900 0.900 accuracy on DeepSeek ), alternative methods offer only marginal difficulty scaling.

sents.en: Naïve Prompting even exacerbates this issue: without execution feedback to verify viability, generation collapses into trivial or flawed tasks where top models score a perfect 1.000 1.000 .

paragraphs.en: Model Performance Across Different Evolution Rounds. We evaluate proxy (in-loop) and held-out models across MetaBench-Harness ’s base, early, and late evolution rounds. As shown in Table 2 , while proxy models typically peak early and decline as late-stage complexity increases, this evolution ultimately enhances benchmark quality: it better distinguishes model capabilities on MB-CodeContests, and escalates difficulty on MB-AIME while preserving strong discriminative power. For held-out models, late-stage difficulty scaling highlights a stark contrast between non-reasoning (NR) and reasoning (R) models. On the highly challenging MB-AIME, NR models suffer a near-total collapse, dropping to a narrow 0.100 0.100 – 0.167 0.167 accuracy band. Conversely, R models demonstrate strong resilience; top reasoners like Kimi-K2.5 and DeepSeek-V3.1 maintain scores of 0.533 0.533 and 0.333 0.333 , respectively. Finally, Table 3 substantiates this increased complexity through reasoning lengths. By the late stage on MB-AIME, Kimi-K2.5 and DeepSeek-V3.1 require significantly more computational effort, generating an additional 14,764 14,764 and 5,536 5,536 tokens, respectively. Ultimately, the preserved discriminative power and increased reasoning effort prove that MetaBench-Harness generates genuinely reasonable benchmarks that test advanced models, rather than merely encouraging unintended shortcuts or flawed heuristics.

paragraphs.en: How does the meta-harness adapt to different domains? As shown in Table 5 , our framework maintains a high acceptance rate for harness proposals across both coding and math scenarios. However, the meta-harness reveals distinct adaptation trends tailored to each domain’s inherent challenges. For coding tasks in CodeContests, the system heavily modifies Measurement (39%). Unlike math, programming tasks cannot be judged by a single final answer alone; they require different unit tests, edge-case checks, and performance tracking. Consequently, the meta-harness frequently updates measurement tools to ensure rigorous evaluation. Furthermore, code execution generates rich intermediate data, necessitating robust Telemetry edits (11%) to capture execution logs, runtime errors, and trace signals for subsequent evolution adjustments. Conversely, math task evolution in MB-AIME concentrates primarily on Generation (60%). Because AIME problems have clear, deterministic numerical answers, the evaluation mechanism is straightforward, placing minimal burden on measurement. Instead, the core challenge lies in evolving the task itself. The meta-harness directs most of its modifications toward task generation and structural mutation, continuously altering constraints and problem settings to prevent models from relying on memorized templates and to push the limits of advanced mathematical reasoning. Lastly, the details of Table 5 can be found in Appendix B.2 , and a round-by-round qualitative analysis is provided in Appendix B.2.2 .

paragraphs.en: Which dimensions of the benchmark’s capabilities are evolved? Having detailed the mechanical edits applied by the meta-harness, this section now examines how these changes fundamentally transform the tasks within the evolved benchmarks. Table 5 compares the original datasets with their counterparts evolved by MetaBench-Harness . Across both domains, the evolved tasks demand more capability stages, indicating a substantial increase in overall task complexity. Evolution elevates task complexity by engaging more capability stages across the solving process. To analyze how task complexity scales, Figure 3 utilizes Claude-Fable-5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) to compare evolved tasks with their original seed questions across two dimensions (difficulty levers and capability dimensions). By sampling a subset of examples for human validation, we confirm high Human–AI agreement of 97.1% and 96.1% for the two dimensions, respectively. Figure 3 (a) shows that both domains evolve primarily by tightening answer criteria and compounding constraints. While mathematical tasks lean toward structural composition, coding tasks increase the scale of required work. Figures 3 (b) and (c) further illustrate the shift in required capabilities following evolution across the two datasets. Mathematical tasks emphasize precise computation, multi-case bookkeeping, and structured output compliance, while coding tasks shift toward constructive solution generation under strict evaluation constraints. See Appendix B.2.3 for a detailed breakdown.

sents.en: Does the benchmark quality improve through evolution?

sents.en: To ensure the evolved benchmarks are meaningful, we pairwise compare evolved tasks against their seeds using a more powerful LLM judge, Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , as summarized in Table 6 .
sents.zh: 为确保演化后的基准具有意义，我们使用功能更强大的 LLM 判官 Claude-Opus-5（Anthropic, 2026b）对演化任务与其初始版本进行两两比较，具体结果总结于表 6。

paragraphs.en: For each dimension, the judge outputs a binary validation, with the reported success rates reflecting the proportion of tasks that meet the criteria. To validate the reliability of the LLM judge, we also measure Human–AI agreement on a sampled subset (reported as the Human column). First, Reasonableness evaluates whether the evolved task remains valid and well-formed, preserving a recognizable lineage while introducing meaningful changes. Second, Competency verifies that the task faithfully measures the intended capability, ensuring that it demands genuine reasoning rather than adding superficial complexity. Lastly, Robustness examines whether the evolved evaluator can reliably distinguish valid from invalid solutions, maintaining strict resistance to formatting artifacts, implementation errors, and adversarial exploitation. Crucially, the Overall metric demands simultaneous success across all three dimensions, with this joint pass rate in the final round substantially outperforming the cross-round average. This consistent upward trend demonstrates that our iterative pipeline progressively converges toward highly valid and structurally robust tasks. (See Appendix B.2.4 for details. )

paragraphs.en: From Seed to Spark: Case Studies. Table 7 shows two task evolution trajectories that highlight our core evolution pattern: the benchmark harness evolved by MetaBench-Harness systematically incorporates difficulty levers to drive multi-dimensional evolution across required capabilities and solving techniques. In Part I (MB-CodeContests), the system transforms the problem type, shifting from a standard constructive math seed to a complex code-auditing task. Similarly, Part II (MB-AIME) evolves a counting problem via compound conjunction and distractor injection , shifting the required skills from pure domain reasoning to include instruction compliance and distractor resistance. Rather than merely scaling difficulty along a single axis, the evolved harness uses diverse levers to formulate questions that demand additional capabilities and solving techniques. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose MetaBench-Harness , a dual-loop framework designed for the end-to-end optimization of benchmark generation workflows. By combining an inner loop for task generation with an outer meta-harness layer that refines harness implementations based on historical trajectories, we transform benchmark creation from a static process into a dynamic evolution. Using CodeContests and AIME-2024 as seed tasks, our experiments show that the framework generates benchmarks that are both challenging and discriminative for models. Supported by trajectory and quality analyses, we verify that it enables multi-dimensional evolution, and steadily improves evolution reasonableness, benchmark competency, and evaluator robustness across successive evolution rounds. Furthermore, case studies quantitatively show that it not only increases the required capabilities and problem-solving techniques, but also uses different difficulty levers to reframe the problems. More broadly, this work provides a solution to static benchmark saturation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 MetaBench-Harness——一个专为基准生成工作流的全流程优化而设计的双循环框架。 通过将任务生成的内循环与基于历史轨迹优化实现的外层元框架相结合，我们将基准创建从静态过程转变为动态演化。 以 CodeContests 和 AIME-2024 作为初始任务，我们的实验表明，该框架生成的基准既具挑战性，又对模型具有区分度。 在轨迹分析和质量分析的支持下，我们验证了该框架能够实现多维演化，并在连续的多轮演化中稳步提升演化的合理性、基准的竞争力以及评估器的稳健性。 此外，案例研究定量表明，该框架不仅提升了模型所需的能力和问题解决技巧，还通过不同的难度调节机制重新定义了问题。 更广泛地说，这项工作为静态基准的饱和问题提供了一种解决方案。

paragraphs.en: In this work, Large Language ¡odels (LLMs) play multiple roles. First, as the core module of our research, they act as agents within the MetaBench-Harness framework for autonomous task generation, evaluator synthesis, and meta-harness orchestration, with their generation quality rigorously assessed through human validation. Second, they serve as the target models evaluated in our experiments. Third, during manuscript preparation, we utilized LLMs strictly as writing assistants. This usage was strictly limited to language refinement, including grammar correction, clarity improvement, and avoiding ambiguous expressions, without generating any scientific claims or core ideas. We explicitly emphasize that all scientific claims, experimental designs, logical arguments, and core contributions were entirely conceived and proposed by human authors in this paper.

paragraphs.en: Master Initialization. Serving as the foundational entry point, this initial setup establishes the operational constraints and global configuration for a MetaBench-Harness run. Executed by ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} (operating as a coding agent with shell access) through a single master configuration file, it specifies the seed dataset, item formatting conventions, overarching objectives, stage sequencing, dual-loop workflow, and the mandatory on-disk locations for all generated artifacts and scripts.

paragraphs.en: Module Instantiation. Guided by the master configuration, ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} executes the workflow’s distinct modules by sequentially traversing the Markdown scaffolds. Treating each prompt as a unit of work, the agent reads prior artifacts, executes its objective, and writes the required outputs (e.g., JSON, Python) to mandated locations. A stage is complete only when these files exist on disk; this rigorous file-passing discipline, rather than a persistent context, robustly carries state through the round.
paragraphs.zh: 模块实例化。 在主配置的指导下，智能体 ℳ \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} 通过依次遍历 Markdown 框架来执行工作流中的各个独立模块。 将每个提示视为一个工作单元，该智能体会读取先前的产物，执行其目标，并将所需的输出（例如 JSON、Python）写入指定位置。 只有当这些文件存在于磁盘上时，一个阶段才算完成；这种严格的文件传递机制，而非持续存在的上下文，能够可靠地在工作轮次中维持状态。

paragraphs.en: Dual-Loop Evolution. This self-evolving workflow organizes the system’s modules into two alternating cycles. The outer loop drives the system’s meta-optimization, where ℳ agent \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} analyzes archived telemetry (e.g., score distributions and failure analyses) to propose, evaluate, and apply edits directly to the benchmark harness’s Markdown scaffolds, effectively rewriting its underlying instructions. Under this updated setup, the inner loop acts as the execution engine for the harness itself. It runs the revised sequence of generation and measurement modules to generate the evolved benchmarks, while collecting fresh telemetry for the next update. This benchmark evolutionary cycle repeats until the stop controller terminates the execution.
paragraphs.zh: 双循环演化。 这种自我演化的工作流程将系统的模块组织成两个交替的循环。 外层循环驱动系统的元优化，其中 ℳ 智能体 \mathcal{M}_{\text{agent}} 分析存档的遥测数据（例如分数分布和故障分析），以提出、评估并直接应用于基准测试框架的 Markdown 骨架中的修改，从而实际上重写了其底层指令。 在这种更新后的设置下，内层循环充当该框架本身的执行引擎。 它运行经过修订的生成与测量模块序列，以生成演化后的基准测试，同时收集新的遥测数据用于下一次更新。 这种基准测试演化循环将持续重复，直到停止控制器终止执行。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark Baselines and Different Evolution Rounds. To establish a comparative baseline that quantifies the difficulty introduced by MetaBench-Harness , we first evaluate models on the original, unevolved seed datasets (e.g., the original CodeContests and AIME-2024 benchmark) which serve as our baselines. To demonstrate how the subsequent evolution process enhances benchmark quality by increasing difficulty and better differentiating model capabilities (results presented in Table 2 ), we analyze specific Early and Late milestone rounds. For MB-CodeContests, we select rounds 2 and 10 to represent the Early and Late stages, respectively. For MB-AIME, rounds 1 and 5 are chosen as the corresponding Early and Late stages.
paragraphs.zh: 基准基线及不同演化轮次。 为了建立一个能够量化 MetaBench-Harness 所引入难度的对比基线，我们首先在原始、未经演化的种子数据集（例如，原始的 CodeContests 和 AIME-2024 基准）上评估模型，这些数据集将作为我们的基线。 为了展示后续演化过程如何通过提升难度和更有效地区分模型能力来增强基准质量（结果见表 2），我们分析了特定的早期和晚期里程碑轮次。 对于 MB-CodeContests，我们分别选择第 2 轮和第 10 轮来代表早期和晚期阶段。 对于 MB-AIME，则选择第 1 轮和第 5 轮作为对应的早期和晚期阶段。

paragraphs.en: Evolved Benchmarks via Different Evolution Methods. To rigorously validate the effectiveness of our approach, MetaBench-Harness , and isolate the performance gains attributed to the evolution method (results presented in Table 1 ), we compare the MetaBench-Harness -evolved benchmark against datasets generated by several alternative methodologies, all of which are evolved from AIME-2024. For external baselines, we generate a comparison dataset using the AutoEvoEval ( Wu and Liu, 2025 ) framework by reimplementing its official specifications. Specifically, we retain its seven question-level operations and rule-based character injection, and randomly sample and perturb scenarios across rounds. Note that we exclude some evolution units that are not related to math or coding. Regarding the TRACE ( Guo et al., 2026 ) methodology, due to its private codebase, we directly report performance metrics from the original paper rather than generating a separate dataset. Furthermore, we construct two internal ablation datasets to evaluate specific evolution components of MetaBench-Harness . First, we produce a dataset using a Naïve Prompting strategy by entirely removing the outer loop and disabling candidate viability mechanisms (i.e., the model-validation and lifecycle-audit stages), meaning candidates are accepted without intrinsic evaluation. Second, we generate a dataset via a Fixed Harness configuration. While this setting also eliminates the outer loop (preventing prompt and configuration edits between rounds), it maintains identical seed items and evaluation logic, thereby isolating the specific impact of harness-level evolution.

paragraphs.en: Proxy and Held-Out Model Setup. To ensure comprehensive coverage of current LLM capabilities and strictly separate the models used for benchmark generation from those used for evaluation (with evaluation results presented in Table 2 ), we categorize our models into proxy and held-out sets. For the proxy models , which drive the in-loop evolution to ensure the generated candidates successfully meet our quality and viability expectations, we utilize Claude-Sonnet-5 as an Adaptive Reasoning model (exhibiting dynamic reasoning and tool-use self-correction) and GPT-5.4 as a Standard Instruct (Non-Reasoning) model. Conversely, for the held-out models , which are evaluated on the resulting benchmarks to verify that the evolved problems effectively enhance discriminative power across unseen architectures, we employ two distinct behavioral classes: Standard Instruct models operating under standard inference budgets (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.1 , Kimi-K2.5 , Gemini-2.5-Flash ), and Test-Time Scaling (Reasoning) models (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.1 , Kimi-K2.5 , Gemini-2.5-Flash , DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/32B ,), which are specialized for long-horizon thinking, self-reflection, and chain-of-thought scaling. As introduced in Section 4.1 , all held-out model evaluations employ standard generation constraints. Notably, the two Qwen reasoning models are evaluated across two strictly budgeted phases: a reasoning phase capped at 96,000 tokens, followed by an answer-extraction phase capped at 32,000 tokens, with the final answer derived exclusively from the second phase.
paragraphs.zh: 代理模型与预留模型设置。 为确保全面覆盖当前大型语言模型的能力，并严格区分用于基准生成的模型与用于评估的模型（评估结果见表 2），我们将模型分为代理模型和预留模型两类。 对于驱动循环内演化的代理模型，其作用是确保生成的候选方案成功满足我们的质量和可行性预期，我们采用 Claude-Sonnet-5 作为自适应推理模型（具备动态推理与工具使用自我修正能力），以及 GPT-5.4 作为标准指令模型（非推理模型）。 相反，对于预留模型，它们将在最终生成的基准上进行评估，以验证演化后的问题是否有效提升了模型在未见过架构上的区分能力。我们采用两类不同的行为模型：在标准推理预算下运行的标准指令模型（例如 DeepSeek-V3.1、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-2.5-Flash），以及用于长期思考、自我反思和思维链扩展的测试时扩展（推理）模型（例如 DeepSeek-V3.1、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-2.5-Flash、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/32B）。 如第 4.1 节所述，所有预留模型的评估均采用标准的生成约束。 值得注意的是，两款 Qwen 推理模型将在两个严格限制预算的阶段进行评估：推理阶段最多使用 96,000 个令牌，随后是答案提取阶段，最多使用 32,000 个令牌，最终答案仅从第二阶段得出。

sents.zh: 对于驱动循环内演化的代理模型，其作用是确保生成的候选方案成功满足我们的质量和可行性预期，我们采用 Claude-Sonnet-5 作为自适应推理模型（具备动态推理与工具使用自我修正能力），以及 GPT-5.4 作为标准指令模型（非推理模型）。

sents.en: Conversely, for the held-out models , which are evaluated on the resulting benchmarks to verify that the evolved problems effectively enhance discriminative power across unseen architectures, we employ two distinct behavioral classes: Standard Instruct models operating under standard inference budgets (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.1 , Kimi-K2.5 , Gemini-2.5-Flash ), and Test-Time Scaling (Reasoning) models (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.1 , Kimi-K2.5 , Gemini-2.5-Flash , DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/32B ,), which are specialized for long-horizon thinking, self-reflection, and chain-of-thought scaling.
sents.zh: 相反，对于预留模型，它们将在最终生成的基准上进行评估，以验证演化后的问题是否有效提升了模型在未见过架构上的区分能力。我们采用两类不同的行为模型：在标准推理预算下运行的标准指令模型（例如 DeepSeek-V3.1、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-2.5-Flash），以及用于长期思考、自我反思和思维链扩展的测试时扩展（推理）模型（例如 DeepSeek-V3.1、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-2.5-Flash、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/32B）。

sents.en: As introduced in Section 4.1 , all held-out model evaluations employ standard generation constraints.
sents.zh: 如第 4.1 节所述，所有预留模型的评估均采用标准的生成约束。

sents.en: Notably, the two Qwen reasoning models are evaluated across two strictly budgeted phases: a reasoning phase capped at 96,000 tokens, followed by an answer-extraction phase capped at 32,000 tokens, with the final answer derived exclusively from the second phase.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，两款 Qwen 推理模型将在两个严格限制预算的阶段进行评估：推理阶段最多使用 96,000 个令牌，随后是答案提取阶段，最多使用 32,000 个令牌，最终答案仅从第二阶段得出。

paragraphs.en: While Section 4.2 analyzes how benchmark harness edits drive domain-specific adaptations, this appendix provides the extended details that underpin the benchmark harness-edit audit (Table 5 ). Specifically, our audit draws on three archived artifacts per candidate, namely the machine-readable proposals, per-round leaderboards, and apply reports, to categorize harness modifications into four functional groups. These groups comprise measurement updates for evaluators and scorers, generation modifications for task evolution and seed selectors, execution adjustments governing runners and configurations, and telemetry refinements for analyzers and early-stopping conditions. Beyond the domain-adaptive trends discussed in Section 4.2 , this fine-grained granular breakdown reveals that a steady minority of edits is actively dedicated to maintaining the instrument itself. Crucially, these maintenance updates introduce execution-reliability fixes like robust timeout handling and retry safety mechanisms, alongside telemetry rules designed to filter out anomalous or confounded scores from lifecycle decisions. Ultimately, these adjustments highlight an organic synergy within the dual-loop workflow. By continuously reinforcing the evaluation environment and filtering unreliable feedback, the outer harness-editing loop ensures that the inner loop can explore increasingly complex problem spaces, thereby driving a stable and continuous evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然第 4.2 节分析了基准测试框架的编辑如何推动特定领域的适应性调整，但本附录提供了支撑基准测试框架编辑审计（表 5）的扩展细节。 具体而言，我们的审计基于每个候选对象的三种存档产物，即机器可读提案、每轮排行榜和应用程序报告，将框架修改分类为四个功能组。 这些功能组包括用于评估器和评分器的测量更新、用于任务演化和种子选择器的生成修改、控制运行器和配置的执行调整，以及用于分析器和提前终止条件的遥测优化。 除了第 4.2 节中讨论的领域适应性趋势外，这种精细的颗粒化分解还揭示，有一小部分编辑持续被专门用于维护工具本身。 关键的是，这些维护更新引入了执行可靠性修复措施，例如稳健的超时处理机制和重试安全机制，同时还设计了遥测规则，以从生命周期决策中过滤掉异常或干扰性的分数。 最终，这些调整凸显了双循环工作流程内部的有机协同作用。 通过持续强化评估环境并过滤不可靠的反馈，外层的框架编辑循环确保了内层循环能够探索日益复杂的问题空间，从而推动稳定且持续的演化。

paragraphs.en: While the statistical breakdowns in Section 4.2 identify which harness components evolved, the main purpose of this section is to examine the model validation feedback to understand how the system simultaneously escalates task difficulty and preserves model discriminability. Specifically, we aim to demonstrate that the meta-harness does not merely apply random mutations, but dynamically reacts to the proxy models’ behaviors by adjusting constraints, fixing formats, and pushing capability ceilings round by round. To capture this interactive process, Figure 4 tracks the longitudinal in-loop validation scores for our proxy models ( Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.4 ), illustrating two distinct evolutionary trajectories for CodeContests and AIME-2024.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然第 4.2 节中的统计分解明确了哪些 harness 组件发生了演化，但本节的主要目的是检验模型验证反馈，以理解系统如何同时提升任务难度并维持模型的区分能力。 具体来说，我们旨在证明 meta-harness 并非仅仅应用随机突变，而是通过调整约束、修复格式以及逐轮推动能力上限，动态响应代理模型的行为。 为了捕捉这一互动过程，图 4 追踪了我们的代理模型（Claude-Sonnet-5 和 GPT-5.4）在循环内的纵向验证得分，展示了 CodeContests 和 AIME-2024 两种截然不同的演化轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Round 1 (Identifying Measurement Defects): The evolution initially records artificially low performance, with Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.4 scoring 0.300 and 0.258. The failure analyzer reveals that out of 180 model-task pairs, 121 fail due to output formatting (e.g., answers wrapped in explanatory text) rather than flawed reasoning, masking the models’ true capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Round 2 (Evaluator Correction): Recognizing that the defect lies in the evaluator rather than the task, the meta-harness strictly corrects the measurement logic by mandating explicit answer markers. Without altering actual task difficulty, scores surge to 0.948 and 0.591, proving that the seed tasks are actually too easy once superficial formatting confounds are removed.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 轮（评估者修正）：认识到缺陷在于评估者而非任务本身，元框架通过强制要求明确的答案标记来严格修正测量逻辑。 在不改变实际任务难度的情况下，得分飙升至 0.948 和 0.591，证明一旦去除表面的格式干扰因素，初始任务实际上过于简单。

paragraphs.en: Rounds 5–10 (Refinement and Final Separation): Although Rounds 5–7 experience a temporary stall, the system learns from ineffective mutations (e.g., asking a model to certify logic it has already mastered, which inadvertently simplifies the task) and retires scenarios that fail to increase difficulty after two consecutive attempts. Leveraging these insights, Rounds 8–9 intensify the remaining tasks. Ultimately, by Round 10, the performance gap between the two models widens significantly to 0.546 (0.839 vs. 0.293), compared to a mere 0.042 margin in Round 1, achieving the dual objective of escalating difficulty while preserving discriminability.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5–10 轮（优化与最终分离）：尽管第 5–7 轮出现了暂时停滞，但系统会从无效突变中吸取教训（例如，要求模型验证其早已掌握的逻辑，这无意中简化了任务），并在连续两次尝试后未能提升难度的场景中被淘汰。 利用这些洞见，第 8–9 轮进一步加大了剩余任务的难度。 最终，到第 10 轮时，两个模型之间的性能差距显著扩大至 0.546（0.839 对比 0.293），而第一轮时这一差距仅为 0.042，从而实现了提升难度与保持可区分性这一双重目标。

paragraphs.en: Distribution of Difficulty Levers. Figure 5 illustrates how the meta-harness applies domain-specific mechanisms to escalate task difficulty. To actively drive complexity, the framework relies on structural levers such as “Output Contract Tightening,” “Compound Conjunction,” and “Distractor Injection.” The AIME-2024 trajectory aggressively utilizes these active mutations: mathematical difficulty is primarily driven by “Output Contract Tightening” (70%) and “Compound Conjunction” (70%), alongside adversarial reframing like “Distractor Injection” (40%). Similarly, in CodeContests, “Output Contract Tightening” (91%) and “Compound Conjunction” (53%) serve as the primary structural drivers, alongside “Scale Up” (33%) and “Meta Level Shift” (30%). However, a domain disparity emerges: mathematical evolution relies more heavily on structural and adversarial reframing, whereas coding evolution spreads its difficulty across a broader range of mechanisms, including “Multi-case Batching” (24%) and “Adversarial Input Seeding” (22%). This indicates that both domains introduce substantive changes beyond mere instance regeneration, while relying on distinct mechanisms to escalate complexity.

paragraphs.en: Shift in Evaluated Capabilities. Figure 6 illustrates the evolutionary shift in the breadth of capabilities required by the benchmarks. To escalate cognitive burden, the framework actively enforces exhaustive state-tracking and strict formatting constraints. In CodeContests, the system pivots toward rigorous algorithmic implementation, driving “Construction Search” to surge from 20% to 90% and “Output Contract” compliance to reach 95%; consequently, the original reliance on pure “Domain Reasoning” (96.4%) drastically drops. Similarly, AIME-2024 aggressively amplifies multi-step execution demands: “Multi-case Bookkeeping” skyrockets from 30% to 100% and “Output Contract” emerges at 70%. While AIME maintains its foundational “Domain Reasoning” (90%), it decisively sheds basic “Spec Parsing” (dropping from 83.3% to 30%). Across both domains, this dynamic demonstrates that successful benchmark evolution builds toward exhaustive search, complex execution, and strict protocol compliance, thereby outgrowing the need to test basic conceptual parsing.

paragraphs.en: Evolution of Solving Techniques. Figure 7 details the shift in the underlying techniques required to crack individual tasks. To actively push models to their limits, the framework enforces rigorous combinatorial searches and survival against adversarial constraints. In CodeContests, evolution creates a massive demand for “Delimiter Protocol Compliance” (96%) and explicit “Magnitude Bound Control” (50%), completely replacing the original dependency on standard “Complexity Budgeting” (which vanishes from 72.7%). Similarly, evolved mathematical tasks in AIME-2024 heavily enforce grueling logical searches dominated by “Combinatorial Enumeration” (90%) and “Maximality Saturation Reasoning” (80%), alongside strict “JSON Schema Compliance” (70%). To make room for these advanced demands, the trajectory decisively abandons standard textbook approaches: initial requirements like “Closed Form Derivation” (63.3%) disappear entirely, while “Exact Integer Arithmetic” plummets from 76.7% to just 10%. Ultimately, by forcing models to master complex casework, distractor resistance, and unyielding protocol adherence, the framework systematically evolves both domains away from straightforward heuristic problem-solving.

sents.zh: 为了为这些高级需求腾出空间，这一发展路径果断摒弃了标准的教科书方法：诸如“闭式推导”（63.3%）之类的初始要求完全消失，而“精确整数运算”的使用率则从 76.7% 骤降至仅 10%。

sents.en: Ultimately, by forcing models to master complex casework, distractor resistance, and unyielding protocol adherence, the framework systematically evolves both domains away from straightforward heuristic problem-solving.
sents.zh: 最终，通过迫使模型掌握复杂的案例处理、干扰项抵抗以及严格的协议遵守，该框架系统性地使这两个领域都脱离了简单的启发式问题解决方式。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the distributions confirm that MetaBench-Harness actively drives domain-specific evolution to increase complexity. In CodeContests, the framework enforces a constraint-based evolution, maximizing difficulty through strict protocol requirements, compound constraints, and meta-level reframing. In contrast, AIME-2024 undergoes active structural evolution, where the system injects distractors and domain-specific structural mutations (e.g., “Modular Reduction Step”) and demands heavy combinatorial casework to build upon the core mathematical foundation. Despite these differences, both domains show that MetaBench-Harness systematically enriches task composition rather than simply lengthening reasoning, adaptively tailoring its mechanisms to each domain’s natural demands.

paragraphs.en: Building on Section 4.2 , this section evaluates task quality across every evolutionary round rather than focusing solely on late-round outcomes. An isolated LLM judge ( Claude-Opus-5 ) assesses each evolved task against its seed across Reasonableness, Competency, and Robustness (Table 6 ). Figure 8 provides the simplified version system prompt, detailing the essential evaluation criteria while omitting operational overhead like I/O formatting. Figure 9 reveals benchmark evolution as an aggressively exploratory, non-monotonic process. While “Evolutionary Reasonableness” remains consistently high, pushing difficulty boundaries causes severe fluctuations in stricter metrics. Sudden metric drops, such as the collapse in “Evaluator Robustness” during CodeContests Round 8 and AIME Round 4, do not indicate systemic failure; rather, they highlight phases where extreme structural mutations temporarily break solver reliability. Crucially, the system exhibits strong self-correction. Following these exploratory crashes, both trajectories recover entirely, converging to robust final metrics (e.g., > 90 % >90\% Evaluator Robustness) and a strict 70% overall acceptance rate (“All Three Yes”). This volatile trajectory proves the framework actively risks temporary quality degradation to discover deeper complexities before successfully stabilizing.
paragraphs.zh: 基于第 4.2 节的内容，本节评估了每个演化轮次中的任务质量，而不仅仅关注后期轮次的结果。 一个独立的 LLM 评判器（Claude-Opus-5）根据合理性、能力与稳健性（表 6），将每个演化后的任务与其初始版本进行比较评估。 图 8 提供了简化版的系统提示词，详细说明了核心评估标准，同时省略了 I/O 格式化等操作负担。 图 9 显示，基准演化是一个高度探索性且非单调的过程。 尽管“演化合理性”始终保持较高水平，但难度边界的突破会导致更严格的指标出现剧烈波动。 指标的突然下降——例如 CodeContests 第 8 轮和 AIME 第 4 轮中“评估器稳健性”的崩溃——并不意味着系统性故障；相反，这凸显了某些阶段中极端结构突变暂时破坏了求解器的可靠性。 关键在于，该系统展现出强大的自我修正能力。 在这些探索性崩溃之后，两条轨迹均完全恢复，并收敛至稳健的最终指标（例如，评估器稳健性 >90%）以及严格的 70% 整体接受率（“三项皆通过”）。 这种不稳定的演化轨迹证明，该框架会主动承担暂时降低质量的风险，以发现更深层的复杂性，并最终成功稳定下来。
